tagline: Build it. Prove it. Ship it.
positioning: Proof over promises. Local-first software with receipts, honest claims, and user-owned workflows.

availabilityTaxonomy.derivation: Availability is about the product, not its newest build lane: a product is AVAILABLE when release.publicVersion names a real public release, even while a newer candidate is also in flight. NO_PUBLIC_RELEASE means no public release of the product exists yet. Whether an artifact is downloadable right now is a separate fact, carried by downloadUrl and stated on the card, never inferred from this taxonomy.

products.name: GhostLayer
products.summary: A controllable RAM-backed layer between active work and permanent storage. Stage files in RAM, open them for editing, recover from interruptions, commit safely with multi-select batch workflow and keyboard shortcuts — no cloud, no account, no telemetry.
products.cardSummary: Stage files in RAM, recover interrupted work, then commit selected changes on your terms.

presentation.valueLine: Keep files in a temporary RAM layer. Review changes and choose what to commit to disk.
presentation.cardImageAlt: GhostLayer staging list showing two files in RAM with commit and discard controls.

Windows SmartScreen may prompt on first launch; choose More info, then Run anyway.

products.releaseNote: Public release v0.4.0 (Windows). Unsigned by Windows — not Microsoft publisher signed, not SmartScreen trusted. The release was verified with 188/188 tests passing, a clean build, and packaged runtime qualification (13/13 steps). v0.4.0 adds multi-select batch workflow (select, Commit Selected, Discard Selected), keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+A, Escape, Shift-click range), tray status tooltips (staged/modified/conflict counts), and safer commit routing that prevents renderer-supplied destination redirection. The tray Discard All bypass has been removed. Verify the SHA-256 before running. Windows SmartScreen may prompt on first launch — choose More info, then Run anyway.
